name: taskade
description: Use Taskade from your AI tool: plan a new Taskade Genesis app for Taskade EVE to build, check your apps, fix an app with proof, make the first screen work on a phone, make an app safe to share, clone an app kit, turn a spreadsheet into an app, publish with a way back, build and test an AI agent, turn the plan of a code repository into a project, and report on your projects and automations. Connects to the hosted Taskade MCP server with your Taskade login. The connection needs a paid Taskade plan. The Markdown skill works with no connection.

interface.longDescription: Plan a new Taskade Genesis app and check the build against the plan, turn a spreadsheet into a Taskade project, fix an app with a checked change, get a status report from your projects and automations, check an app and make it safe to share, clone an app kit, or publish with a backup and a way back. Make the first screen work on a phone, build and test an AI agent, or turn the plan of a code repository into a project. Sign in with your Taskade account. Taskade EVE, the builder inside Taskade, builds apps and automations from the request that the plugin writes. You publish an app in Taskade.
defaultPrompt: Turn this spreadsheet of leads into my Taskade CRM and skip duplicates
Give me a status report of my Taskade workspace for this week
